summary: Q1 2026: Net sales +17% to $181.5B (vs $155.7B Q1 2025), ~2% above consensus. AWS revenue $37.6B, ahead of expectations. EPS $2.78 vs $1.64 estimate (+69.5%). Amazon launched Amazon Supply Chain Services (logistics-as-a-service, called 'AWS of Logistics'). $200B capex projected for 2026. AI deals with OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta. Stock at ~$272 on May 5.
